title: Facet Coater
description: For over two decades, the Canadian Photonics Fabrication Centre (CPFC) at the National Research Council of Canada (NRC) has operated as a mission-critical facility supporting Canada’s photonics and semiconductor innovation ecosystem. The CPFC provides advanced fabrication and metrology services for both internal research programs and external clients, enabling the development and production of cutting-edge photonic devices used in telecommunications, sensing, and quantum technologies. Photonic devices are critical pieces of hardware for high-performance computing in various innovative fields such as artificial intelligence (AI), data centres, automotive LiDARs (Light Detection and Ranging), biomedical, aerospace; security, and quantum industry/applications. The global market for compound semiconductor foundry services is growing rapidly, presenting niche opportunities and challenges for Canada. Limited access to compound semiconductor foundry services poses several challenges to develop, successfully introduce, and supply new products in an increasingly competitive marketplace. Photonic devices fabricated on InP wafers must undergo several “back-end” steps before dicing and packaging, adding time and cost if the assembled parts are then found to be defective. This project will establish the capability at CPFC to deliver known good die (KGD) to clients, to reduce time and cost for new product introduction (NPI). To provide KGD, a new clean room (ISO 6) will be constructed (retrofit of a current facility) to house numerous automated tools, such as Dual Ion Beam Sputter Deposition (DIBS) Laser Facet Coating Systems. This project will address an immediate client need for timely introduction of new products into a competitive marketplace.

title: Financial Consultant - Alberta for the Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS)
description: The Programs Branch (PB) of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) has requirements on an “as and when requested” basis for professional resources with expertise and skillsets for the delivery of financial counselling and mediation services. This requirement is to establish a Task Authorization Contract with a qualified Contractor’s for services in Alberta. It is intended to result in the award of 4 (four) contracts for 5 (five) years. The Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS) offers free financial counselling and mediation services to farmers who are having difficulties meeting their financial obligations. It is a voluntary, private and confidential service that brings farmers and their creditors together with a Mediator in a neutral forum to reach a mutually acceptable solution. The FDMS Administrator will assign a Financial Consultant and a Mediator to work with the farmer through the mediation process. Confidentiality is extremely important to the quality and effectiveness of the service. Information obtained from the farmer and their creditor(s) is used for the sole purpose of mediation and is shared only among the parties involved in the mediation process. The Financial Consultant will conduct a site visit, inventory all the farmer’s assets, create financial statements of the farming operation, develop a recovery plan for the purpose of reaching a financial arrangement between the farmer and their creditor(s), and attend mediation meeting(s). When the farmer and their creditor(s) agree upon a solution, the Mediator will draw-up an arrangement

title: Contrat cadres Assistant à Maîtrise d’Ouvrages région ouest
description:
armasuisse Immobilier, BM Ouest / Lausanne, gère un portefeuille de projets de construction, d’entretien, d’assainissement et d’adaptation technique répartis sur plusieurs régions de Suisse romande. Une part importante de ces opérations concerne des projets de petite et moyenne ampleur.


Le présent appel d’offres a pour objet la conclusion de contrats-cadres régionaux avec des prestataires d’assistance au maître d’ouvrage (AMO), chargés d’appuyer les chefs de projet du maître d’ouvrage dans la préparation, le pilotage, le suivi et la documentation des projets du portefeuille régional, sans se substituer à eux ni aux mandataires de planification et de réalisation.


Afin de garantir la sécurité d’utilisation et d’exploitation, de s’adapter aux nouvelles prescriptions, d’assurer la responsabilité du maître d’ouvrage, etc., un important portefeuille de projets d’entretien et de développement a été établi par armasuisse Immobilier.


Afin de garantir la réalisation rapide des projets de remise en état et de répondre aux besoins des locataires, BM Ouest recherche des partenaires fiables en tant qu’assistants au maître d’ouvrage, disposant des ressources nécessaires et du savoir-faire requis pour mener à bien ces missions rapidement et de manière durable.


Le présent appel d’offres vise à désigner un mandataire AMO par lot. Un contrat-cadre est conclu avec chaque adjudicataire pour une durée ferme de quatre ans, avec possibilité de prolongation d’une année. Les prestations sont confiées au moyen de commandes KBOB no 33 fondées sur le contrat-cadre KBOB no 32 (pièces D et E du présent dossier).


La zone d’intervention est répartie par lots régionaux ; le présent mandat concerne les sites et périmètres indicatifs listés au chapitre 3 du présent document.


Le présent macrhé est divisé en 9 lots regroupant plusieurs sites géographique de armasuisse Immobilier :

  • Payerne DC/Aviation
  • Grolley / Belfaux
  • Drognens / Romont
  • Chablais (Aigle, Hongrin)
  • Valais (Dailly, Savatan)
  • Bure / Jura
  • Chamblon / Pied du Jura Nord
  • Bière / Pied du Jura Sud
  • Genève


Pour chaque lot, le marché comprend la réalisation de prestations pour les domaines suivants :

  • Assistance à la maitrise d’ouvrage


Le soumissionnaire peut déposer une offre pour un ou plusieurs lot, chaque lot sera évalué séparément et fera l’objet d’une adjudication distincte.


Les règles relatives à l’allotissement et au nombre de lots pouvant être adjugés par soumissionnaire seront précisées.

title: Kuhmon kaupungin varainhoidon palveluiden hankinta
description: Kuhmon kaupungin varainhoidon palveluiden hankinta Kuhmon kaupungin sijoitustoiminnan piiriin kuuluvan varallisuuden alkupääoma on peräisin vuodelta 2002, jolloin kaupunki perusti 21.2.2002 valtuuston päätöksellä § 18 kehittämisrahaston, jonka alkupääoma oli 12.500.000,00 euroa. Rahaston tarkoituksena on edistää Kuhmon elinkeinoelämää, vetovoimaisuutta ja varmistaa Kuhmo-strategian mukaisten merkittävien peruspalveluinvestointien rahoitusta. Sijoitusvarallisuus on kehittynyt sijoitustoiminnan tuottojen seurauksena. Rahavarojen määrä muuttuu sen mukaan, kuinka vuotuinen tulorahoitus riittää toiminnan kulujen sekä investointien rahoittamiseen. Noin 26 M€ osuus kaupungin likvideistä rahavaroista per 30.9.2026 arvioidaan olevan sijoitettavissa pitkäaikaisesti. Kaupunki kilpailuttaa kyseisen sijoitusvarallisuuden kahdessa (2) erillisessä hankinnan osassa, missä kummankin hankinnan osan kohteena on lähtökohtaisesti noin 13 M€ arvopaperisalkun täyden valtakirjan varainhoito sisältäen osake- ja korkosijoitukset kaupungin sijoituspolitiikassa määriteltyjen periaatteiden ja rajoitteiden mukaisesti. Kaupunki tekee hankinnan perusteella kaksi (2) erillistä hankintasopimusta kahden (2) eri palveluntarjoajan kanssa. Kummallakaan palveluntarjoajalla ei ole yksinoikeutta kaupungin sijoitusvarallisuuden hoitamiseen. Kaupunki ei sitoudu tiettyyn vähimmäismäärään varainhoitajalle hoidettavaksi annettavan sijoitusvarallisuuden osalta. Kaupungilla on sopimuskauden aikana oikeus lisätä tai vähentää kummankin varainhoitajan hoidettavana olevaa sijoitusvarallisuutta kaupungin rahoitus-, investointi- ja sijoitustarpeiden perusteella. Sijoitusvarallisuuden muutokset eivät muuta hankinnan kohteena olevan palvelun sisältöä tai hinnoitteluperiaatetta, vaan varainhoitopalvelun palkkio määräytyy kulloinkin hoidettavana olevan varallisuuden perusteella tarjouksessa ilmoitetun hinnan mukaisesti. Kaupunki ei myöskään sitoudu siihen, että mahdollisesti sopimuskauden aikana sijoitettavaksi tuleva uusi varallisuus jaetaan tasapuolisesti tai ennalta määrätyssä suhteessa varainhoitajien kesken. Kaupunki päättää mahdollisesti sopimuskauden aikana sijoitettavaksi tulevan uuden varallisuuden allokoinnista omien rahoitus-, investointi- ja sijoitustarpeidensa perusteella. Tarjoukset pyydetään täyden valtakirjan varainhoidosta. Hankinta toteutetaan määräaikaisena hankintasopimuksena kestoltaan kuusi (6) vuotta ja lisättynä mahdollisella kahdella yksittäisellä yksivuotisella optiokaudella (1+1 vuotta). Yksinomaan kaupungilla on oikeus, mutta ei velvollisuutta optiokausien käyttämisestä ilmoittamalla siitä kirjallisesti vähintään 6 kuukautta ennen kulloisenkin sopimuskauden päättymistä. Kaupungilla on oikeus käyttää optiokausia joko yksi kerrallaan tai molemmat peräkkäin. Varainhoito on luonteeltaan pitkäjänteistä sijoitustoimintaa, jossa varainhoitajan sijoitusstrategian ja toiminnan arviointi edellyttää riittävän pitkää tarkastelujaksoa ja mahdollisuutta arvioida toimintaa erilaisissa markkinaolosuhteissa. Lyhyempi sopimuskausi voisi johtaa tarpeettomiin palveluntarjoajan vaihtoihin sekä niistä aiheutuviin hallinnollisiin ja transaktiokustannuksiin. Kuuden vuoden sopimuskausi mahdollistaa kaupungille varainhoitajan toiminnan arvioinnin pitkäjänteisesti useissa erilaisissa markkinaolosuhteissa ja vähentää tarpeettomasta palveluntarjoajan vaihtamisesta aiheutuvia kustannuksia ja operatiivisia riskejä. Hankintamenettelyssä sovelletaan avointa hankintamenettelyä ja kyseessä on EU-kynnysarvon ylittävä palveluhankinta. Hankintamenettelyssä tarjoukset pyydetään liitteinä olevien "Tarjouspyyntö varainhoidon palveluista" (liite 1) Kuhmon kaupungin ”Sijoitussuunnitelma”- dokumentin sisältämien kirjausten ja mahdollistamien rajojen mukaisesti (liite 2). Liikkeellelähtövaiheen toimenpiteistä ja menettelytavoista, esim. siirtyykö mahdollisille uusille varainhoitajille olemassa olevia arvopapereita tai yksinomaan rahavaroja, neuvotellaan palveluntarjoajien kanssa sopimusta tehtäessä erikseen, jolloin valittavien varainhoitajien kanssa tehtävässä sopimuksessa määritellään, minkä ajan puitteessa sovittua sijoituspolitiikkaa noudatetaan. Kuhmon kaupungin tavoitteena on löytää luotettavat ja osaavat kumppanit, jotka pystyvät tarjoamaan ammattitaitoista ja kustannustehokasta varainhoitoa vastaamaan kaupungin tarpeita sekä varmistaa varainhoitoon uskottujen pääomien sijoitussuunnitelman mukainen, laadukas, vastuullinen ja kilpailukykyinen varainhoito. Kaupungin sijoitustoiminnassa vastuullisuusasioiden huomioiminen läpi koko sijoitusprosessin on tärkeää. Sijoitussuunnitelmassa on kerrottu tarkemmin kaupungin periaatteista vastuulliseen ja kestävään sijoittamiseen.,

Tavaran tulee täyttää myös seuraavat vaatimukset: - pitkäkestoiseen käyttöön soveltuvia - laadukkaista ja kestävistä materiaaleista valmistettuja - kuljetusvaunujen avulla helposti siirrettäviä ja varastoitavia - huollettavissa elinkaaripalveluna Hankintaan sisältyy lisäksi Tavaran pakkaus sekä kuljetus Kansallismuseon toimipisteeseen (Mannerheimintie 34). Tarjoajan tarjousta vastaavat tuotenäytteet pöytien jalkamekanismista sekä käytettävästä päytälevymateriaalista tulee toimittaa Hankintayksikön arvioitavaksi viimeistään 20.11.2026, jotta tarjotut tuotteet voidaan arvioida tarjouspyynnössä esitettyjen vertailuperusteiden mukaisesti osana tarjousten vertailua. title: Hochwasserschutz Dorf Alpthal - Vormassnahmen
description:
Die Ausführung des Hochwasserschutzprojekts wird in zwei separaten Losen erstellt.

-      Los Vormassnahmen

-      Los Hauptarbeiten

Die vorliegende Ausschreibung umfasst die Arbeiten vom Los Vormassnahmen. Das Los Hauptarbeiten ist nicht Bestandteil dieser Ausschreibung.

Die Arbeiten beim Los Vormassnahmen umfassen folgende Massnahmen:

 

Geissbergbach

Oberhalb der Hochweidstrasse wird ein neuer Geschiebesammler erstellt. Der Einlaufbereich wird mit Blöcken in Beton ausgeführt. Als Auslaufbauwerk wird eine Betonmauer mit eingesetzten Stahlträgern (Rechen) erstellt. Der Unterhaltszugang zum Geschiebesammler erfolgt ab der Hochweidstrasse über eine neue Erschliessungsstrasse mit Schotterrasen. Der best. Durchlass Hochweidstrasse bleibt unverändert.

Oberhalb des Kiessammlers wird das Gerinne mittels einer neu erstellten Beckenstruktur mit Schwellen, bestehend aus 1.5 bis 2.5 Tonnen schweren Blöcken in Beton, auf den nötigen HW-Querschnitt ausgebaut. Die Blöcke in den Böschungen werden nicht einbetoniert. Weiter oben, ausgangs des Waldes, wird mittels Terrainanpassung ein Ablenkdamm erstellt.

 

Hochweidbach

Oberhalb der Hochweidstrasse wird das Gerinne ausgebaut und der Abflussquerschnitt vergrössert, um das Wasser fassen zu können. Im steilen oberen Bereich wird der Bach durch Blöcke und Schwellen als Beckenstruktur gestaltet.

 

Mattlibach

Im Oberlauf des Mattlibachs wird ein Geschiebesammler mit einem neuen Auslaufbauwerk erstellt. Der Einlaufbereich wird mit Blöcken in Beton ausgeführt. Das Auslaufbauwerk wird mittels Rechenkosruktion ausgebildet und schliesst an die bestehende Eindolung an.

 

Karlismattbach

Oberhalb des Siedlungsrandes am Haggeneggweg wird ein neuer Geschiebesammler erstellt. Der Einlaufbereich wird mit Blöcken in Beton ausgeführt. Als Auslaufbauwerk wird eine Betonmauer mit eingesetzten Stahlträgern (Rechen) erstellt. Für den Bau sind vorgängig Umlegungen von Werk- und Quellwasserleitungen erforderlich.

Der Unterhaltszugang zum Geschiebesammler erfolgt über eine neue Erschliessungsstrasse mit Schotterrasen.

 

Unterhalb des Kiessammlers wird das Gerinne mittels einer neu erstellten Beckenstruktur mit Schwellen, bestehend aus 1.5 bis 2.5 Tonnen schweren Blöcken in Beton, auf den nötigen HW-Querschnitt ausgebaut. Die Blöcke in den Böschungen werden nicht einbetoniert.

Der kleine, bereits vorhandene Kiessammler bleibt unverändert bestehen.

 

Die detaillierten Massnahmen und genauen Abgrenzungen sind in den Projektpläne ersichtlich.

Die einzelnen Baustellen sind auf verschiedene Teilperimeter verteilt und nicht zusammenhängend. Die Zwischentransporte von Aushubmaterial und Humus sind teilweise Bauplatzübergreifend, wobei die öffentlichen Strassen und Grundstücke/Strassen Dritter gequert werden müssen.

title: Vertical Transportation Equipment (VTE): Maintenance, Repair, and Inspection at Aviano Air Base, Italy
description: This full maintenance contract signifies a VTE service provider (Contractor) takes total service responsibility for the equipment identified in the contract. Except those services covered in paragraph 2 of PWS, the monthly fixed price includes all inspections, maintenance, repairs, replacements, and routine and emergency service calls. Contractor shall provide service calls (routine and emergency) under the full maintenance service agreement at no additional charge. All repair work shall be done in accordance with standard commercial practices. Emergency calls are defined as calls made for services when a VTE system fails and constitutes a danger to personnel; threatens to damage properties; or threatens to disrupt activity, operations, and/or training missions. Three (3) facilities are considered to be mission critical. Mission critical facilities are located in Appendix B of PWS. The elevator mechanic may be required to respond and to assist the Aviano Air Base Fire Department in extricating trapped passengers. Contractor is required to provide a two (2) years warranty for repairs and any system implementation work executed IAW European/Italian laws and norms. The contractor will provide emergency maneuver training to the Aviano Air Base Fire Department personnel on yearly basis (once per each option year of the contract), dates and times determined within 60 days of contract start date. Potential offerors are to quote on the following line items, quotes are due to this office by: 16 November 2026 @ 16:00 hrs. Central European Time (CET). Any questions are due NLT 09 November 2026 @ 11:00 CET. A Site Visit is planned for 30 October 2026, at 09.30 am (CET) and will be held at Aviano Air Base Italy. Meeting point: Aviano Air Base, Italy, LVIS Gate, (you can search it on Google maps), SP31, Fontanafredda (PN), Italy. All prospective offerors are highly encouraged to attend the site visit to inspect the sites where the services are to be performed. In no event shall failure to inspect the sites constitute grounds for an award protest. All offerors who intend to participate in the site visit shall coordinate base access through the Contracting Office: 1. A maximum of two people per company will be allowed to participate. 2. Contractor shall provide the names and cellphone number of its company representatives attending the site visit not later than two calendar days prior to the established site visit date (30 October 2026 at 10.00 am CET), to: melissa.maurhart.it@us.af.mil; brady.corbitt@us.af.mil;

title: Medium Unmanned Surface Vessel (MUSV) Phase II Integration and Testing
description: The Department of the Navy Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager (DRPM) / Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) for Robotics and Autonomous Systems (RAS) hereby issues this announcement regarding a forthcoming Area of Interest (AOI) for Medium Unmanned Surface Vehicles (MUSV) Phase II Integration and Testing. MUSV uses modular design principles to create adaptable and resilient solutions that can effectively counter evolving threats. We invite interested parties with expertise in innovative solutions to complex problems, vessel construction, autonomy, perception systems, and general maritime experience to participate in this opportunity. Vendors will be evaluated on platform maturity, open-architecture autonomy compatibility, endurance, payload integration capacity, and rapid-production scalability. To meet the critical operational demand signal for high-volume autonomous vessel procurement over the next decade, DRPM RAS will employ innovative and streamlined acquisition pathways. The government will leverage the authorities of 10 U.S.C. 3458 (Commercial Solutions) and 10 U.S.C. 4022 (Other Transactions) and intends to award Basic Ordering Agreements and prototype other transaction agreements, and potentially production contracts or transactions to successful vendors. To maintain technical superiority and capture rapid commercial innovations, DRPM RAS intends to issue the AOI with a rolling open window. This open call will allow new entrants to compete and existing vendors to submit updated product blocks and modular payload configurations. Approved platforms will be accepted into the maritime marketplace hosted on drones.mil. This digital clearinghouse will empower authorized acquisition authorities and operational stakeholders across the Department of War enterprise to rapidly configure and issue funded delivery orders for vetted maritime autonomous systems without redundant procurement cycles. Formal AOI release is planned on or before September 30, 2026. Detailed AOI instructions will be released via SAM.gov and syndicated at https://drones.mil. Interested industry vendors capable of delivering commercial or dual-use maritime unmanned surface systems are encouraged to ensure active SAM.gov registrations and monitor this notice for amendments, industry day announcements, and formal AOI documentation. All inquiries concerning this notice must be submitted in writing to the Agreements Officer at Christopher.j.murr.civ@us.navy.mil (note this email is distinct/different than the auto generated SAM.gov). ______________________________________________________________________________________________________________Update_as_of_23_September_2026_______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ DRPM RAS is issuing this Call For Solutions (CFS) under the Drone Marketplace Commercial Solutions Opening W58RGZ26SC001. The presolicitation notice N0003926RR002 (notice ID N0003926R0R02) has resulted in the CFS W58RGZ-26-S-C001-0008 issued herein. The CFS posting is in place of the aforementioned Area of Interest (AOI), a separate AOI will not be posted. All parties are encouraged to review the specific terms of the CFS posted as an attachment to this SAM.gov posting.

title: UNI - Bastions Central _ CFC233.00 - Lustrerie sur mesure
description:
L’Université Bastion à Genève fait l’objet d’un projet global de rénovation visant une transformation à la fois architecturale et fonctionnelle de l’ensemble existant. L’objectif des travaux est une revalorisation durable de la structure bâtie, en tenant compte des exigences actuelles en matière d’architecture, d’usage, de technique et d’efficacité énergétique.


L’accent est mis sur le développement respectueux du patrimoine bâti historique, tout en intégrant des standards contemporains sur le plan des infrastructures et de l’expression architecturale. Dans ce contexte, des aspects tels que la qualité des espaces, la flexibilité des usages ainsi qu’une approche architecturale claire jouent un rôle central.


Les travaux ont d’ores et déjà débuté et l’exploitation du site se poursuit actuellement dans un contexte de chantier en cours. La mise en service est prévue pour l’année académique 2027 / 2028.


Cet appel d'offre se déroulera en deux phases. Au premier tour, les soumissionnaires devront fournir les documents demandés ainsi que les échantillons de la lentille et du support en métal, selon les indications de l'appel d'offres. Après analyse des dossiers transmis, 3 candidats seront sélectionnés et invités à participer à la 2e phase en fonction des critères de sélection.

title: Belgium – Construction work – Bouwen van FacThory 2/3 te Genk
description: Deze opdracht betreft de realisatie van een bedrijfsverzamelgebouw voor de innovatieve maakeconomie FacThory 2/3 te Genk in opdracht van Mo-Thor NV. De opdracht wordt onderverdeeld in volgende vijf delen: Deel 1, ruwbouw, afwerking en algemene coördinatie der werken Dit deel omvat alle voorbereiding van het bouwterrein, grondwerken, structuurwerken, metselwerken, rioleringswerken, dakwerken en buitenschrijnwerk. Alle afwerkingen zoals pleisterwerken, lichte wanden, systeemwanden, vloerafwerkingen en plafonds, binnenschrijnwerk, vaste uitrustingen en schilderwerken, … (niet limitatief), maken eveneens deel uit van dit deel. De coördinatieopdracht, zijnde alle taken en verantwoordelijkheden die betrekking hebben op de coördinatie in tijd en ruimte tussen de verschillende delen van de Opdracht, behoort eveneens tot het takenpakket van de Aannemer. Deel 2, elektriciteit, data en veiligheidsinstallaties Dit deel omvat alle elektrische -, data- en veiligheidsinstallaties binnen en buiten het gebouw. De aannemer aan wie dit deel van de werken wordt toegewezen, en die als onderaannemer van de algemene hoofdaannemer zal optreden, zal als Aangeduide Onderaannemer worden vermeld in de Aanvraag tot Deelneming, voor zover deze voor de Kandidaat noodzakelijk is om aan de kwalitatieve selectievoorwaarden te voldoen. Deel 3, HVAC, sanitair en brandbestrijdingsinstallaties Dit deel omvat alle verwarmings-, ventilatie- en luchtbehandelingsinstallaties met inbegrip van alle elektrische voorzieningen hiertoe, alsook het gebouwbeheersysteem. Daarnaast omvat dit deel alle sanitaire- en brandbeveiligingsinstallaties binnen en buiten het gebouw met inbegrip van de pompinstallaties en alle elektrische voorzieningen hiertoe. Ook de sprinklerinstallatie maakt deel uit van dit deel. De aannemer aan wie dit deel van de werken wordt toegewezen, en die als onderaannemer van de algemene hoofdaannemer zal optreden, zal als Aangeduide Onderaannemer worden vermeld in de Aanvraag tot Deelneming, voor zover deze voor de Kandidaat noodzakelijk is om aan de kwalitatieve selectievoorwaarden te voldoen. Ter info wordt hierbij meegedeeld dat er zal aangesloten worden op een bestaande KWO-installatie. Deel 4, liften Dit deel omvat de liftinstallaties binnen het project. De aannemer aan wie dit deel van de werken wordt toegewezen, en die als onderaannemer van de algemene hoofdaannemer zal optreden, zal als Aangeduide Onderaannemer worden vermeld in de Aanvraag tot Deelneming, voor zover deze voor de Kandidaat noodzakelijk is om aan de kwalitatieve selectievoorwaarden te voldoen. Deel 5, omgevingsaanleg Dit deel omvat onder meer de grondwerken ten behoeve van de terreinaanleg, terreinverhardingen en bijhorende rioleringswerken, groenaanleg en buitensignalisatie (niet limitatief). De aannemer aan wie dit deel van de werken wordt toegewezen, en die als onderaannemer van de algemene hoofdaannemer zal optreden, zal als Aangeduide Onderaannemer worden vermeld in de Aanvraag tot Deelneming, voor zover deze voor de Kandidaat noodzakelijk is om aan de kwalitatieve selectievoorwaarden te voldoen. De te realiseren gebouwen en infrastructuur, de visie, gehanteerde uitgangspunten en beoogde doelstellingen, het voorziene materiaalgebruik en uitvoeringswijze, worden bondig toegelicht inde Projectdefinitie, dewelke als Bijlage 6 bij deze Selectieleidraad is gevoegd. Daarnaast wordt het aanvraagdossier voor stedenbouwkundige vergunning (enkel de plannen) als Bijlage 7 bij deze Selectieleidraad gevoegd, zodat de Kandidaten zich een beeld kunnen vormen van de beoogde realisatie, doch louter ter informatie en zonder dat de Kandidaten hieraan enige rechten kunnen ontlenen.

title: R402--Real Estate Acquisition Support Services (FY21 New Broker IDIQ) -- TIERED EVALUATIONS
description: 36C10F20R0073 Presolicitation Notice Lease Acquisition Support Services (New Broker IDIQ) This is a presolicitation announcement for the Department of Veteran Affairs (VA), Office of Construction and Facilities Management (CFM). A Request for Proposal (RFP) will be issued on this Federal Business Opportunities (www.fbo.gov) website after 15 days after the release of this Notice. Lease Acquisition Support Services are required for a multiple award Broker Services Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract. This multiple award is set-aside for small businesses which will including Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) or Veteran Owned Small Business (VOSB) on a tiered evaluation. The firms must be a licensed leasing broker with an approved NAICS Code of 531210. The intent is to award nine (9) contracts; however, awards may vary dependent on the best interest of the Government. The term will be one (1) base year and four (4) one-year option periods at the discretion of the Government. The minimum guarantee amount for the base period is $1,000.00. The contract will be a firm fixed-price IDIQ contract with a maximum amount of $30,000,000.00 per awardee over the contract period. The determination of acquisition strategy lies solely with the Government. All firms are cautioned to review the restrictions of FAR 9.5 Organizational and Consultant Conflicts of Interest. Any broker services firm that receives a request for proposal (RFP) for broker services will be restricted from participating in any other contract or task order for that particular project. This contract will be procured in accordance with FAR Part 15, this procurement is best value with tradeoffs. Firms must have an established working office and must be capable of responding to and working on multiple task orders concurrently. The Performance Work Statement (PWS) will include: Module 1 Lease Acquisition Support Services, CLIN 0001 thru 0004 will be commission fee. The Contracting Officer will determine whether to procure task orders for Module 1 services using CLIN 0001 thru 0004. Only CLIN 0001 thru 0004 will be allowed for module 1 lease acquisition services at the Task Order level. The services described below may include all or a combination of the following steps: 1) participating in a project orientation with the PM and LCO, other Government personnel, and other contractors; 2) providing GREX support; 3) advertising the requirement; 4) surveying the market and preparing a market survey report; 5) drafting issuing a LCO approved RLP and any RLP amendments; 6) conducting administrative reviews of offers; 7) inputting proposal financial data into analysis tools for LCO analysis and evaluation; 8) providing support to LCO in negotiations and discussions with offerors; 9) preparing the lease documents and any lease amendments, and coordinating required signatures; 10) coordinate Acceptance Inspection; and 11) support to VA with FOIA inquiries, Congressional and other governmental inquiries, claims, litigation, settlements, and disputes. The Contractor must hold a current state broker license in the United States of America OR Commonwealth of Puerto Rico. Additionally, in order to be awarded a lease acquisition TO, the Contractor must provide a broker license covering the state where the lease is being performed. Module 2 Lease Related Acquisition Support Services, CLIN 0005 as described in the PWS. Related services include User Group Design Meetings with Lessor; Lessor's Tenant Improvement (TI) Pricing Review; Change Orders; Construction Schedule and Initial Construction Meeting; Construction Progress Reporting; Coordination of VA Occupancy; Pre-Acceptance Submissions, Market research and analysis; Disputes, Protests, Claims, and Appeals, Congressional Inquiries, and FOIA Inquiries; Disputes/Protests, Claims/Appeals; and FOIA/Congressional/Other Inquiries. Module 3 Due Diligence Services, CLIN 0006, the Government requires certain due diligence studies prior to the award of a lease. Application of lesser requirements than what are listed in this Contract or in the PWSs provided must be approved by the Lease Contracting Officer within the Task Order on a case-by-case basis, in writing. The Contractor is responsible for verifying that all subcontractors possess industry-specific qualifications as required by Federal, State and local jurisdictions and licensing bodies. Subcontractors that do not possess the required qualifications shall not be utilized. The Contractor is also responsible for vetting subcontractors for potential conflicts of interest and for subcontractors compliance with access agreements and other arrangements between the Government and other landowners pertaining to use, access, and restoration activities. This contract will be procured in accordance with FAR Part 15, this procurement is best value with tradeoffs. title: R402--Real Estate Acquisition Support Services (REASS) Recompete
description: Notice of VISN-Based Solicitation Structure Since release of the prior draft solicitation, the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) has refined the acquisition strategy for Real Estate Acquisition Support Services to align with the Veterans Health Administration s (VHA) evolving regional operating model. This revised approach supports VA s broader Restructure for Impact and Sustainability Effort (RISE), an organizational transformation directed by Executive Order 14210. RISE is intended to streamline VHA structures and processes, strengthen regional implementation and accountability, and support more consistent, coordinated, and responsive services for Veterans. Accordingly, VA has transitioned from a single nationwide contractor-pool approach to a multiple-award IDIQ structure organized by Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) Coverage Area. Benefits of the VISN-based approach include: Allowing qualified SDVOSB offerors to compete for one or more VISN Coverage Areas rather than requiring a nationwide proposal; Enabling offerors to focus proposals on geographic areas where they can demonstrate staffing, local-market resources, capacity, and lawful authority to operate; Supporting focused competition and VISN-specific commission pricing; Improving alignment between broker support, VA regional lease-acquisition operations, and local-market requirements; Strengthening accountability for contractor capacity, performance, quality control, and continuity of services within each VISN Coverage Area; and Supporting VA s broader effort to simplify operations, improve consistency, and enable more effective implementation at the regional and local levels. VA considered feedback received during the draft-solicitation/RFI phase. However, because the solicitation has been materially revised since the draft-solicitation/RFI phase, VA is not posting the historical draft-stage questions and Government responses. Those historical responses may not reflect the requirements, proposal instructions, evaluation approach, or procedures in the final solicitation. The final solicitation, its attachments, and any written amendments issued by the Contracting Officer are the only authoritative sources for solicitation requirements. Offerors shall submit questions concerning the final solicitation in accordance with the solicitation s instructions.

title: Request for Information (RFI) � Combat Rubber Raiding Craft (CRRC) Outboard Motors
description: This Sources Sought Synopsis (SSS)/Request for Information (RFI) is issued for informational purposes and market research only; it does not constitute a solicitation. The Government will not reimburse any company or individual for any expenses associated with preparing/submitting information in response to this posting. The information provided may be used by the Government in developing its acquisition strategy, statement of work/statement of objectives, and/or performance specifications. Interested parties are responsible for adequately marking proprietary or competition sensitive information contained within their response as instructed later in this posting. The United States (US) Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC), Intelligence, Surveillance and Reconnaissance & Special Operations Forces (ISR & SOF) Directorate, Special Warfare (SW) Program Office (AFLCMC/WISN) is conducting market research to identify possible sources capable of providing a CRRC Outboard Motor (OE). The current Guardian Angel (GA) weapon system relies on CRRC Outboard Motors that are nearing the end of their service life and no longer fully meet the evolving requirements of the Personnel Recover (PR) mission. The obsolescence of the current motor fleet restricts operational capabilities and increases mission risk. Specifically, the inability to operate reliably in rough seas limits the ability to conduct PR missions in certain geographic locations and weather conditions. The current program lacks a viable replacement solution that addresses these deficiencies, restores the weapon system�s full operational capability, and provides GA personnel with a reliable and effective CRRC-system for all operational environments. Furthermore, the decreased horsepower and increased unit weight of modern potential replacement EPA compliant 4-stroke Outboard Motors (OE) reduce operational capability and aerial delivery mission flexibility. PLEASE SEE ATTACHMENT FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS AND INFORMATION ON HOW TO RESPOND TO THIS RFI.

title: SB ERS MATOC, USACE Northwestern Division and EPA Region 2
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Kansas City District is procuring a Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for Environmental Remediation Services (ERS) in support of United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Northwestern Division (NWD) and the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Region 2. The MATOC will be procured on a competitive basis as a total small business (SB) set-aside under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 562910 Environmental Remediation Services. The scope of the SB ERS MATOC includes in-situ thermal remediation, in-situ chemical oxidation, and other chemical stabilization of contamination; operations and maintenance of remediation systems including large scale groundwater treatment plants, soil vapor extraction systems, and air sparge systems; preparation of work plans; studies with associated reports; multiple phases of field investigations; preliminary assessments; site inspections and remedial site inspections; remedial investigations; feasibility studies; Engineering Evaluation Cost Analysis; monitoring well installation and sampling; short and long term monitoring/long term operations or Long Term Response Action (LTRA); data management; data interpretation; engineering evaluation and corrective actions; optimization studies; ground-water modeling; geophysical surveys; remediation cost estimates; management of non-hazardous and hazardous investigative derived waste; environmental and human health risk assessments; risk based remediation; air emission issues including vapor intrusion; surface water discharge; applying for environmental permits; remedial design; well abandonment; meetings; public meeting participation; preparation of presentation material both written and visual; hydrological, sediment and soil studies; project reports; engineering support and/or design; value engineering studies; operations and maintenance for hazardous, toxic, and radioactive waste (HTRW) sites; energy evaluations for remediation systems; remedial action plans; remedial actions; removal action plans; removal actions; construction support; site closeout/decision documents; abandoned mines program support; and future project programming and scheduling support. The solicitation will be made available no earlier than 15 days after this presolicitation notice. All responsible sources may submit a proposal in response to the solicitation, which the government will consider in the award decision. This notice does not constitute a commitment on the part of the Government to award a contract, nor to pay for any costs incurred as a result in replying to this notice. This notice should not be construed as a commitment by the Government for any purpose.

title: Epinephrine Injector
description: The Defense Logistics Agency is issuing a solicitation for a national requirements contract for Epinephrine Injectors. Procurement details follow. Epinephrine 0.3 MG/0.3 ML Injection, Auto-Injector 2S in 2 count bottles. This will be an unrestricted and fully competitive acquisition. The contract will be a firm-fixed price, requirements type contract with a one-year base and four one-year options. A contract resulting from this solicitation will establish a national supply source, in accordance with FAR 52.216-21 (Requirements), to provide the items listed in the schedule for purchase by Department of Defense, Department of Veterans Affairs, Indian Health Service and Bureau of Prisons customers through the DLA and VA prime vendor programs. The annual usage estimates will be provided in the Schedule of Supplies section of the solicitation. This is a commercial item and will be solicited using FAR part 12. All sources may submit a proposal which shall be considered by the agency. A copy of the solicitation will be posted to the DLA Bid Board System (DIBBS) at https://www.dibbs.bsm.dla.mil and Sam.Gov at https://sam.gov. Interested parties should contact Jeremy Brown at (445) 737-5419, (jeremy.brown@dla.mil) for any questions/comments. Interested parties are further advised to set up automated notifications of pre-solicitation or solicitation changes through this website. The current solicitation date is October of 2026.

title: Callao, Peru Infrastructure Modernization - U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) � Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA)
description: ****SOURCES SOUGHT FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY**** This announcement seeks information from industry which will be used for preliminary planning purposes. No proposals are being requested or accepted with this announcement. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION FOR PROPOSALS AND NO CONTRACT SHALL BE AWARDED FROM THIS SYNOPSIS. NO SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS OR DRAWINGS ARE AVAILABLE AT THIS TIME. 1. AGENCY: United States Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA) 2. NAICS: 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction 3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE: Peru 4. ACQUISITION INFORMATION: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Latin America and Caribbean District (SAA), is issuing this Sources Sought announcement as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support a potential future design-build construction project at the Callao Naval Base, Lima, Peru. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. Estimated Magnitude of Construction: Between $25,000,000 and $50,000,000. Performance Period: 540 days after Notice to Proceed. Anticipated Award Date: Fiscal Year 2027 Quarter 3 Small Business Programs: In accordance with FAR 19.000(b)(1)(ii), the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO) has elected not to apply FAR Part 19 (Small Business Programs) to this overseas procurement. Consequently, small business set-asides will not be utilized for this project in Peru. However, all responsible sources�including both U.S. concerns (large and small) and foreign entities�are encouraged to submit responses to this Sources Sought notice. 5. ANTICIPATED ACQUISITION STRATEGY: The acquisition strategy for this requirement will be determined based on the responses to this Sources Sought notice and other market research. The Government is considering several compliant acquisition pathways to ensure the successful delivery of this complex Design-Build project in Peru. All interested firms are strongly encouraged to submit a comprehensive capabilities statement, as the information received will be critical in determining the final method of procurement. The primary anticipated strategy is a Two-Phase Design-Build procurement under the authority of FAR Part 36.3. In this scenario, the Government would issue a public Phase 1 solicitation requesting offeror qualifications. Based on these qualifications, the Government would down-select the most highly qualified firms (typically no more than five) who would then be eligible to compete in Phase 2 and submit detailed technical and price proposals. However, based on the unique challenges of performing complex construction in Peru, the Government is also considering the following alternative strategies: Option 1: Limited Competition under FAR Part 6, Other Than Full and Open Competition. If market research reveals that only a very limited number of sources possess the unique combination of Design-Build expertise, mandatory Peruvian licensing (Registro Nacional de Proveedores - RNP), and demonstrated experience with specialized facilities (e.g., POL, medical, secure warehouses) in the local market, the Government may justify limiting competition. Option 2: Establishment of a Qualified Bidders List (QBL) under FAR Part 9.2. If the operational environment in Peru and the specialized nature of the requirement warrant it, the Government may decide to establish a formal Qualification Requirement. Under this authority, the Government would create a list of pre-qualified firms that demonstrate the essential standards for technical capability, financial stability, and in-country operational capacity. Future solicitations for this requirement would then be limited to firms on this established QBL. The Government�s final decision will be based on which strategy provides the best value and ensures a competitive environment among responsible and qualified contractors capable of meeting the demanding technical and logistical requirements of this project. 6. PROJECT DESCRIPTION: The contemplated scope consists of complete Design-Build services�including geotechnical verification, site preparation, civil works, architectural and engineering design after award, structural construction, mechanical/electrical/plumbing (MEP), specialized HVAC/fire suppression, Defense Base Act (DBA) insurance coverage, and Furniture, Fixtures, & Equipment (FF&E). Facility / Scope Package Primary Function Key Technical Considerations Building 110 Spare Parts Warehouse Heavy-duty slab design, industrial racking integration, material handling flow, automated logistics staging. Building 115 Clothing & Gear Warehouse High-density pallet storage, humidity and climate control, inventory distribution bays. Building 112 Material Warehouse Bulk staging, overhead crane/hoist accommodations, heavy equipment ingress/egress ramps. Building 113 Customs Warehouse Secure bonded holding areas, host-nation customs inspection layout, physical security infrastructure. Building 114 Petroleum, Oil, and Lubricants (POL) Warehouse Secondary containment, explosion-proof electrical systems, specialized foam/water fire suppression, environmental drainage controls. Building 111 Medicine & Medical Supplies Warehouse Temperature/humidity-controlled storage (cold chain capability), pharmaceutical-grade clean finishings, backup power integration. Building 120 DIRNOTEMAT & Quality Control Building Administrative offices, testing and quality inspection laboratories, specialized testing benches, IT/telecom infrastructure. Site & Ancillary Works Infrastructure & Integration Site grading, structural fill, perimeter security, access roads, utility connections, complete FF&E packages, and host-nation compliant permitting. 7. SOURCES SOUGHT: The purpose of this source sought is to gain knowledge of interest, capabilities and qualifications of contractors who have the capabilities to complete and perform contracts of this magnitude, and to address any questions, recommendations or concerns from Industry. The Government must ensure there is adequate competition among potential pool of responsible contractors. Prior Government contract work is not required for submitting a response under this Sources Sought announcement. The result of this market research will contribute to determining the method of procurement. 8. RESPONSES: The Capabilities Statement for this Sources Sought is not intended to be a Request for Proposal nor Invitation for Bid, nor does it restrict the Government to an ultimate acquisition approach. It is to request statements regarding the company's ability to demonstrate existing-or-developed expertise and experience in relation to the areas specified herein. Any commercial brochures or currently existing marketing material may also be submitted. This synopsis is for information and planning purposes only and is neither to be construed as a commitment by the Government nor will the Government pay for information solicited. Respondents will not be notified of the results of the evaluation. Interested parties are requested to provide a capabilities statement addressing the following areas. Section 1: Company Information Company Name, Address, and Website Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone, Email) CAGE Code and SAM UEI Number Business Size and Status (e.g., Small Business, Large Business) Bonding: What bonding or guarantee methods are available to your company to secure contract performance and protect downstream subcontractor/labor payments for a project located in Peru? Please specify if your company utilizes US Treasury-listed Surety Bonds, Peruvian Bank Letters of Guarantee (Carta Fianza), or Insurance-backed Guarantees (P�liza de Cauci�n). Relevant NAICS Codes Section 2: Interest and Experience in Peru Please confirm your company's interest in performing a design-build construction project of this magnitude and complexity in Lima, Peru. It includes inspection, component repair and replacement,reassembly and testing procedures required to return units back into a servicable condition. 3.2 2.0 DEFINITIONS. 3.2.1 CONTRACTOR: Is defined as the successful offeror awarded a contract, orderor issued a project work order. The term "contract" encompasses a contract, an order, or a project work order. 3.2.2 OVERHAUL: An overhauled part is one which has been disassembled, cleaned, inspected, repaired as necessary (by replacing or repairing all components which have been found to exceed limits established by the repair/overhaul manual) reassembled and tested in accordance with the approved repair/overhaul manual listed in this SOW and returned to a Ready for Issue (RFI) condition (Refer to contract schedule for items to be overhauled). 3.2.3 REPAIR: A repaired part is one which has been restored to a Ready for Issue(RFI) condition (by replacing or repairing those components found to be defective, broken, damaged or inoperative during the initial evaluation and troubleshooting phase) and tested in accordance with the approved repair/overhaul manual listed in this SOW (Refer to contract schedule for items to be repaired). 3.3 3.0 SCOPE 3.3.1 GENERAL. SCOPE 1.1 The material covered in this contract/purchase order will be used in a crucial shipboard system. The use of incorrect or defective material would create a high probability of failure resulting in serious personnel injury, loss of life, loss of vital shipboard systems, or loss of the ship itself. Therefore, the material has been designated as SPECIAL EMPHASIS material (Level I, Scope of Certification, or Quality Assured) and special control procedures are invoked to ensure receipt of correct material. 1.1.1 DSSP Scope of Certification Material - Material Control Division ;(B); applies to this material. 1.1.2 This ;CANISTER; contains non-metallic materials which must satisfy the toxicity and flammability requirements of NAVSEA SS800-AG-MAN-010/P-9290. title: Pentolite
description: U.S. Army Combat Capabilities Development Command � Armaments Center (DEVCOM-AC), Munitions Engineering Technology Center (METC), Explosives Integration Branch FCDD-ACM-EW at Picatinny Arsenal, NJ, is conducting market research to determine the ability to manufacture and produce Pentolite. DISCLAIMER: �THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A �REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)� TO BE SUBMITTED. IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. RESPONSES IN ANY FORM ARE NOT OFFERS AND THE GOVERNMENT IS UNDER NO OBLIGATION TO AWARD A CONTRACT AS A RESULT OF THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION OF RESPONSES TO THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. ANY INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY. RESPONSES WILL NOT BE RETURNED TO THE RESPONDER. NOT RESPONDING TO THIS NOTICE DOES NOT PRECLUDE PARTICIPATION IN ANY FUTURE REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ) OR INVITATION FOR BID (IFB) OR RFP, IF ANY ISSUED. IF A SOLICITATION IS RELEASED, IT WILL BE SYNOPSIZED ON THE GOVERNMENT-WIDE POINT OF ENTRY (GPE). IT IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF POTENTIAL OFFERORS TO MONITOR THE GPE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION PERTAINING TO THIS REQUIREMENT.� REQUIREMENT: Pentolite is a sensitive secondary HE very often used for NOL (Naval Ordinance Laboratory) Large and Extra-Large Scale Card Gap Tests (LSGT & ELSGT). AOP-7 and DoW specifications require that materials be qualified via these tests before being considered for use in any DoW items.. Similar, lower-grade material is manufactured by other sources for commercial mining and blasting operations. It is feasible for one of these facilities to accept a DoW contract for the higher-grade material required. In addition, please provide Full company name and address, point of contact with telephone number and email address, CAGE Code and DUNS number, size of business (i.e. large, small, disadvantaged, veteran owned, woman owned, etc.) and applicable NAICS and Product Service Code�s (PSC), and website (if applicable). Vendors must be properly registered in the Government System for Award Management database (SAM). Contractors may obtain information on SAM registration and annual confirmation of requirements by calling 1-866-606-8220, or via the Internet at www.sam.gov. This is a market survey for information only and shall not be construed as a request for a proposal or as an obligation on the part of the US Government. The US Government does not intend to award a contract on the basis of this market survey or otherwise pay for information solicited. The official response must be submitted to the U.S. Army Contracting Command � Rock Island at Picatinny. Please send responses to Contracting/Agreements Officer Charlotte Sylvain-Ceraul at charlotte.a.sylvain-ceraul.civ@army.mil and Contract Specialist, Antonius Gill at antonius.gill.civ@army.mil no later than November 16, 2026, at 3:30 p.m. Eastern Standard Time. title: FY27 Communications and Networking Applied Research Announcement for Office of Naval Research
description: The purpose of this announcement is to focus attention of the scientific community on (1) the area to be studied, and (2) the planned timetable for the submission of white papers and full proposals. The goal of the Communications and Networking Program within the Office of Naval Research (ONR 311) is to support the Navy's Information Warfare vision by developing measurable advances in technology that can directly enable and enhance end-to-end connectivity and quality-of-service for mission-critical information exchange among widely dispersed naval, joint, and coalition forces. The vision is to provide high throughput robust communications and networking to ensure all warfighters � from the operational command to the tactical edge � have access to information, knowledge, and decision-making necessary to perform their assigned tasks. The ONR program is interested in white papers for potential FY27 Applied Research (Budget category 6.2) projects under the following focus areas: Development of long-range VHF-band data link, using compact 4x4 Multiple-Input, Multiple-Output (MIMO) based on 5G/Commercial-Off-The Shelf (COTS) and sub-MHz frequency channelization (spectral efficiency in excess of 1 bit/Hz); Novel design and prototyping of compact electronically-steered apertures for higher frequencies (i.e., above Ka-band); Innovative approaches and technologies for low probability-of-detection communications against advanced electronic threats; Advanced techniques for distributed network control, synchronization, and/or scheduling; and New algorithms for predicting network behavior/performance or emerging operational requirements that are translated into traffic engineering policies. The ONR is receptive to innovative ideas, which are not within the above focus areas, but nonetheless are important to the Navy/Marine Corps communications and networking, as otherwise described in this Topic Description

title: RFI Lupus Research Program (LRP) Public
description: The Congressionally Directed Medical Research Programs (CDMRP) seeks feedback to inform potential future Lupus Research Program (LRP) focus areas and associated research funding opportunities. Although fiscal year 2027 (FY27) funds have not been appropriated, the LRP is requesting this information to support program planning processes. The CDMRP wants to hear from all audiences, interested parties, and individuals from academia, industry, community and non-profit organizations, scientific and professional organizations, federal agencies, and the public. This RFI is for information and planning purposes only and should not be construed as a solicitation or an obligation on the part of the LRP or the Department of War. BACKGROUND: The CDMRP represents a unique partnership between the U.S. Congress, the military, and the public to fund innovative and impactful medical research in targeted program areas. The CDMRP LRP�s vision is to cure lupus through partnership of scientists, clinicians and persons affected by lupus. The LRP�s mission is to fund research to understand, prevent, and diagnose lupus and to improve treatments and quality of life of patients, including Service Members and their Families, Veterans and the general public. Appropriations for the LRP from FY17-24 and FY26 totaled $75 million. As of October 2026, FY27 funds for the LRP have not been appropriated. If appropriated, the CDMRP will utilize its two-tier review process https://cdmrp.health.mil/about/2tierRevProcess) to efficiently manage the LRP. Additional information about the LRP can be found here: https://cdmrp.health.mil/lrp/ RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS: Please provide responses to this RFI by clicking on the following link: https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/FY27-LRP-RFI

title: FY27 Nursing Practice Oversight Course (NPOC)
description: REQUEST FOR QUOTATION (RFQ) RFQ FA800326Q0012 1.0 GENERAL INFORMATION 1.1 Introduction, Background & Purpose. This Request for Quotation (RFQ) is a competitive action conducted on the open market as a Combined Synopsis/Solicitation in accordance with (IAW) Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. The Air Force Installation Contracting Center (AFICC) 771 ESS/EGA has a requirement for a comprehensive commercial audiovisual (AV) equipment lease/rental with incidental setup, teardown, and on-site technical standby support for the 2027 Nursing Practice Oversight Course (NPOC) Conference in support of Air Force Medical Command (AFMEDCOM). This requirement is a Total Small Business Set-Aside under North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 532490 (Other Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Rental and Leasing) and Product Service Code (PSC) W099 (Lease or Rental of Equipment: Miscellaneous). The Government intends to award a single, Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) contract utilizing a Lowest Price Technically Acceptable (LPTA) evaluation methodology. The Period of Performance (POP) is event-specific, running from 22 February 2027 through 24 February 2027. Responses will be posted directly to SAM.gov (www.sam.gov). Quotation Submission. Quotations must be submitted by 4:00 PM on MONDAY, 16 NOVEMBER 2026. Quotations received after this deadline will not be considered for award. 1.4 General Terms and Conditions. Compliance: The quotation must comply with the terms and conditions of this RFQ. Non-conformance may result in an unfavorable evaluation or the quotation being removed from consideration. Discrepancies: If a Quoter believes these instructions contain an error, omission, or ambiguity, they shall immediately notify the Government POCs via email with supporting rationale prior to the quotation deadline. Exceptions: Any exceptions to the specific terms and conditions of this RFQ (e.g., the Statement of Work (SOW) or evaluation criteria) must be clearly identified and explained within the quotation's Cover Letter, detailing the specific RFQ document, page, paragraph, and a complete rationale. Quote Validity Period: Quotations must stipulate that the quoted pricing and terms remain valid for a minimum of 160 days from the date of submission. 2.0 QUOTATION PREPARATION & SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS. 2.1 General Submission Instructions. The Government will not evaluate any pages that exceed the stated page limits. Tables of Contents will not count against any stated page limits. Quotations must be submitted via email to the POCs identified in Section 1.2 prior to the deadline established in Section 1.3. Quoters shall submit their entire quotation in exactly three (3) separate electronic files, formatted and organized as follows: Table 1. Quotation Organization. description: Der öffentliche Auftraggeber ist zuständiger Aufgabenträger im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr (ÖPNV) nach § 8 Abs. 3 Satz 1 PBefG i. V. m. § 6 Abs. 1 des Gesetzes über die Planung, Organisation und Gestaltung des öffentlichen Personennahverkehrs Baden-Württemberg (ÖPNVG BW). Der Auftraggeber ist gem. § 6 Abs. 3 ÖPNVG BW damit auch zuständige Behörde im Sinne der EU-Verordnung (EG) Nr. 1370/2007 (VO 1370/2007). Der Landkreis ist damit für die Sicherstellung eines ausreichenden Verkehrsangebots in seinem Wirkungskreis zuständig (§ 8 Abs. 3 PBefG). Nachdem die aktuelle Verkehrsbedienung im Linienbündel BB02 zum 30.06.2027 endet, war die Verkehrsleistung ab dem 01.07.2027 zu gewährleisten, mithin neu auszuschreiben. Zur Vergabe kommen die Busverkehrsleistungen auf den nachfolgenden aufgelisteten VVS-Linien: – Linie 634 Weissach - Flacht - Rutesheim - Leonberg – Linie 634A Weissach - Flacht - Perouse - Rutesheim (Schülerverkehr) – Linie N62 Leonberg - Gebersheim - Rutesheim - Perouse - Flacht - Weissach und zurück Es handelt sich ausschließlich um Linienverkehre die nach § 42 PBefG genehmigt werden sollen. Der Auftragnehmer hat den vorgegebenen Fahrplan zu erfüllen; dieser ist in Anhang LB.1 beigefügt. In Anhang LB.2 und Anhang LB.3 finden sich die zugehörigen Planungshilfen. Im Rahmen der Inbetriebnahme des Eisenbahninfrastrukturprojektes Stuttgart 21 (S21) kann es zu Verschiebungen im S-Bahn- und/ oder Regionalverkehr kommen. Die Deutsche Bahn hat im Juni 2026 eine stufenweise Inbetriebnahme ab vrsl. Dezember 2031 angekündigt. Daher sind die vorgegebenen Busfahrpläne nach Umstellung der S-Bahn- und/oder Regionalverkehre durch den Auftragnehmer auf Kompatibilität mit den dann geltenden S-Bahn- und/ oder Regionalverkehrsfahrplänen zu überprüfen. Mögliche Anpassungen sind mit dem Aufgabenträger und ggf. dem VVS rechtzeitig abzustimmen und umzusetzen. Das Letztentscheidungsrecht hat der Aufgabenträger. Der Auftraggeber stellt klar, dass es sich bei dem beschriebenen Mechanismus um Optionen im Sinne des § 132 Abs. 2 S. 1 Nr. 1 GWB handelt, welche im Falle einer, auch späteren, Inbetriebnahme von S 21 eine Auftragsänderung ohne Neuausschreibung ermöglichen. Die Auftragsvergabe fällt in den Anwendungsbereich der Richtlinie 2009/33/EG des Europäischen Parlaments und des Rates (Richtlinie zur Förderung sauberer Fahrzeuge — CVD). Näheres ist Ziff. 5.1. zu entnehmen.

title: Core Research Program Technology Transfer & Commercialization Advancement
description: The Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA) Research and Development (R&D) Core Research Program announces this competitive solicitation for proposals focused strictly on Technology Transfer (T2) and Commercialization Advancement. The core objective of this Research Announcement is to accelerate the transition of high-impact pipeline safety innovations from advanced laboratory and operational prototypes to full-scale commercial deployment and operational field implementation across the Nation's energy transportation infrastructure. This solicitation specifically targets mature technologies at high Technology Readiness Levels (TRL 7�9) to bridge the critical 'implementation gap' by resolving final technical, regulatory, operational, credentialing, and market hurdles. Funding will only be awarded for projects that demonstrate a clear, definitive path to producing deployable technology, commercial products, or integrated service system ready for immediate market availability and pipeline operator adoption upon project completion.

buyer: Stadt Lörrach - Fachbereich Stadtentwicklung und Stadtplanung
title: Offener zweiphasiger städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischer Realisierungswettbewerb als vorgeschalteter Planungswettbewerb für eine Vergabe im Verhandlungsverfahren nach VgV "Zukunft Krankenhaus-Areal Lörrach"
description: In absehbarer Zukunft werden die Kreiskliniken des Landkreises Lörrach und das St.Elisabethen-Krankenhaus im neuen Zentralklinikum Lörrach (Dreiland-Klinikum- Lörrach), im Nordosten der Stadt vereint. In diesem Zusammenhang wird auch der Standort des Kreiskrankenhauses in Lörrach aufgegeben. Das ca. 3,5 ha große innenstadtnahe Areal zwischen der Röntgenstraße im Süden, der Spitalstraße im Osten, der Körnerstraße im Norden und dem Gewerbekanal „Neuer Teich“ im Westen, wird an die Stadt Lörrach zurückfallen und für eine Folgenutzung frei. Das Krankenhaus-Areal ist einer der wichtigen Transformationsorte der Stadt und im Kontext mit der Weiterentwicklung der Gesamtstadt zu sehen. Die Entwicklung des Areals soll dementsprechend im Kontext der Stärkung Lörrachs als urbane und lebenswerte Stadt in der Region verstanden werden. Ziel ist es, mutige, innovative und unkonventionelle Entwurfsansätze zu entwickeln, die den gegenwärtigen Städtebau hinterfragen und eine auf Lörrach zugeschnittene neue Urbanität schaffen, die Klimaanpassung mit Nutzungsmischung, soziale Teilhabe und Mehrgenerationenfähigkeit konsequent und resilient umsetzt. Das künftige Areal soll unter möglicher Berücksichtigung des Teilerhalts vorhandener Strukturen und der Umnutzung einiger potenzieller Gebäudeteile als urbanes Quartier neu überplant werden. Ziel ist es, ein zukunftsfähiges Quartier zu schaffen und zusätzlich eine Perspektive für die Weiterentwicklung der unmittelbaren Umgebung und angrenzender Gebiete vor-zubereiten. Die städtebauliche und freiraumplanerische Transformation des Areals, in Etappen und langfristig, ermöglicht ein innenstadtnahes durchmischtes Quartier mit dem Schwerpunkt auf Wohnen und Nutzungen der Gesundheitsvorsorge, Erholung sowie sozialer und gewerblicher Infrastruktur und vereint eine angemessene zukunftsorientiere Dichte mit innerstädtischen Freiräumen und Klimaanpassung. Wettbewerbsgegenstand: Städtebaulich-freiraumplanerische Vorentwurfsplanung (Leistungsphase 2) für das künftige urbane Quartier in Lörrach. Wettbewerbsverfahren: Offener zweiphasiger städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischer Realisierungswettbewerb gemäß der RPW 2013, mit anschließendem Verhandlungsverfahren nach der VgV. Die Beurteilung und Auswahl der Teilnehmer*innen in der ersten Phase, die für die Bearbeitung des städtebaulich-freiraumplanerischen Realisierungswettbewerb (2. Phase) zugelassen werden, erfolgt anhand einer „Kreativaufgabe“ durch das Preisgericht. Der Wettbewerb wird im Rahmen der VgV 2016, i.V.m. § 3 Abs. 3 RPW 2013 durchgeführt und ist anonym (gemäß § 1 Abs. 4 der RPW 2013). Im Anschluss an das Wettbewerbsverfahren, nach Abschluss der 2. Phase, werden gemäß § 14 Abs. 4 Ziff. 8 VgV die Preisträger*innen zu Vergabeverhandlungsgesprächen eingeladen. Beauftragung: Die Ausloberin wird, unter Würdigung der Empfehlungen des Preisgerichts, eine*n der Preisträger*innen (§ 8 Abs. 2 RPW 2013) mit der Leistungsphase 3 des städtebaulichen Entwurfs und der Leistungsphase 3 des freiräumlichen Entwurfs beauftragen. Gemäß der Vergaberichtlinien nach VgV sind mit allen Preisträger*innen Verhandlungsgespräche zu führen. Rechtsgrundlage: Richtlinien 2014/24/EU VgV - Verordnung über die Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge - Deutsch RPW 2013 - Richtlinie für Planungswettbewerbe - Deutsch Teilnahmeberechtigt sind: Natürliche Personen, die gemäß Rechtsvorschrift ihres Heimatlandes am Tag der Bekanntmachung zur Führung einer der folgenden Berufsbezeichnungen berechtigt sind (Richtlinie 2005/36/EG Berufsanerkennungsrichtlinie): Stadtplaner*in, Landschaftsarchitekt*in, Architekt*in. Interdisziplinäre Bewerber*innen oder interdisziplinäre Bewerbergemeinschaften, die die fachlichen Voraussetzungen erfüllen. Fachliche Voraussetzungen sind die Berechtigungen zur Führung der folgenden Berufsbezeichnungen gemäß Rechtsvorschrift des Herkunftsstaates: Stadtplaner*in, Landschaftsarchitekt*in, Architekt*in. Erfüllt ein*e Bewerber*in die fachliche Voraussetzung allein oder zusammen mit fest angestellten Mitarbeitern*innen ist er*sie allein teilnahmeberechtigt. (Der*die Mitarbeiter*in / die Mitarbeiter*innen ist / sind in der Verfassererklärung explizit zu nennen.) Bei juristischen Personen sind die fachlichen Anforderungen erfüllt, wenn der satzungsgemäße Geschäftszweck Planungsleistungen sind, die der Wettbewerbsaufgabe entsprechen. Außerdem muss der*die zu benennende bevollmächtigte Vertreter*in und der oder die Verfasser*innen der Wettbewerbsarbeit insgesamt die oben genannte fachliche Anforderung erfüllen. Ist in dem Herkunftsstaat die Berufsbezeichnung nicht gesetzlich geregelt, so erfüllt die entsprechende fachliche Anforderung, wer über ein Diplom, Prüfungszeugnis oder sonstigen Befähigungsnachweis verfügt, dessen Anerkennung gemäß der Richtlinie 2013/55/EU- „Berufsanerkennungsrichtlinie“ - gewährleistet ist. Mehrfachbeteiligungen natürlicher oder juristischer Personen oder von Mitgliedern von Bewerbergemeinschaften führen zum Ausschluss der Beteiligten. Teilnahmehindernisse sind in § 4 Abs. 2 RPW beschrieben. Sachverständige, Fachplaner*innen, Berater*innen müssen die Teilnahmebedingungen nicht erfüllen. Benennung Landschaftsarchitekt*in: Die Benennung des*der Landschaftsarchitekt*in muss bis zum Ende der Frist zur 1. Phase erfolgt sein (16.11.2026, 23:59 Uhr). Frist zur Einreichung der Bewerbung zur Teilnahme: 16.11.2026, 23:59 Uhr. buyer: BEW Berliner Energie und Wärme GmbH
title: Germany – Construction work – DSP - Pumpenhaus Scharnhorststraße Dezentral
description: Das Projekt DSP – Dezentral Scharnhorststraße Pumpenhaus ist eine Infrastrukturmaßnahme zur Erweiterung und Modernisierung des Heizwerks Scharnhorststraße. Am Standort Scharnhorststraße wird eine neue Wärmeübertragerstation mit zwei Pumpengruppen, Rohrleitungssystemen sowie den erforderlichen elektro- und leittechnischen Einrichtungen in einer „Brownfield-Umgebung“ errichtet. Die Umsetzung erfolgt innerhalb eines bestehenden Heizwerksstandortes in einer Brownfield-Umgebung. Neben der Errichtung neuer Anlagenkomponenten sind zahlreiche Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Anlagen, Rohrleitungssystemen, elektro- und leittechnischen Einrichtungen sowie betrieblichen Prozessen zu berücksichtigen. Besonderes Augenmerk liegt dabei auf der Aufrechterhaltung der Versorgungssicherheit und die Umsetzung aller relevanten Umschlussarbeiten innerhalb eines drei (3) monatigen Stillstandsfensters. Für die Umsetzung des Projektes werden in einem vorgelagerten Projekt bereits die erforderlichen Voraussetzungen zur Baufeldfreimachung geschaffen. Aufbauend darauf umfasst das Projekt DSP die Ausführungsplanung, Beschaffung, Errichtung, Inbetriebsetzung und Übergabe der neuen Anlagentechnik einschließlich aller hierfür erforderlichen Nebenleistungen. Auszuführende Arbeiten: • Montage und Umbau von Fernwärme-Anlagenkomponenten • Installation und Integration von Pumpensystemen mit elektrischer Antriebstechnik • Rohrleitungsbau für Fernwärmeanwendungen einschließlich Verbindung und Einbindung von Anlagenteilen (Nennweiten ca. DN 200 bis DN 600) • Anbindung neuer Rohrleitungen und Komponenten an bestehende Versorgungs- und Rohrleitungssysteme • Lieferung und Montage von Armaturen, Regel- und Absperreinrichtungen (Nennweiten ca. DN 250 bis DN 600) • Planung und Errichtung von Rohrleitungsbefestigungen sowie unterstützenden Stahlbaukonstruktionen • Einbindung bestehender Anlagenkomponenten in neu errichtete Systeme • Herstellung von Fundamenten für Anlagen- und Stahlbaukomponenten • Anpassung und Erweiterung von Niederspannungs-, Energieversorgungs- und Antriebssystemen • Anpassung und Erweiterung von Mess-, Steuerungs- und Leittechnik • Erneuerung elektrischer Energieversorgungsanlagen einschließlich Kabelverlegung • Demontage und Rückbau bestehender Anlagen- und Rohrleitungskomponenten (Nennweiten bis ca. DN 500) Die Anbindungen an das Netz erfolgen auf dem Betriebsgelände. Die oberirdische Zuführung der beiden DN500 Leitungen auf dem Betriebsgelände auf einem bestehenden Stahlbau gehört zum Projektumfang. Die vorhandene und zu erweiternde Leittechnik ist auf dem Betriebsgebäude verortet. Die Planung der E- und Leittechnik sind Bestandteil vom Projektumfang. Schnittstellen zur bestehenden E- und Leittechnik sind vorhanden und zu berücksichtigen.

title: Sweden – Cleaning and sanitation services – Städ, särskilt boende
description: Värnamo kommun och omsorgen upphandlar städ, för allmänna ytor på särskilt boende. Vidare ingår även eventuellt kommande städuppdrag för Värnamo kommun, där kommunens egna städverksamhet har behov. Alternativt kommande enskilda städuppdrag från kommunens olika verksamheter. Behoven kan vara olika och avropen beskriver det enskilda uppdraget. Det finns idag 10 stycken särskilda boenden (boendesammanställning bilaga 6) och med en total yta på cirka 10500 m². Fördelat på allt från kontor, toaletter, personalrum, förråd, entréer till samlingslokaler. Det uppskattade avtalsvärdet är 6 mkr och takvärdet cirka 7 mkr. Den upphandlande enheten garanterar dock ingen specifik volym då den verkliga volymen både kan överstiga samt understiga angivna volymer. Information gällande ESPD: Det framgår när man lämnar anbudet i e-Avrop att man som anbudsgivare kan välja att bocka för/ur ESPD-formuläret. Det är en valmöjlighet och inte ett krav att bifoga ESPD
